description: Turkish Army Skywagon held as a teaching airframe at the Ege Üniversitesi aviation school campus at Fatih Mahallesi, Gaziemir. Construction number 185-0841. spottingmode records a Bell 206 and a second U-17 at the same campus but links no identities for them. Last updated 19 March 2025.
